body: Source repo and module path [with user]: SUPERSEDED by the kalide rename (requirements.requirement.kalide-rename): the private repo is now `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` (git@github.com:really-knows-ai/kalide.git) and the Go module path is `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide`. History: an earlier decision set repo/module `github.com/really-knows-ai/ey-present`, which itself superseded `github.com/ey/eypres` (plan/feedback text only). Planned/code FQNs under go.github.com/really-knows-ai/ey-present/... must be re-pointed to go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/... by the plan-writer.
